Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses a specialized metabolic labeling strategy (2H2O) which does not fit standard LFQ/TMT/SILAC categories, hence 'Other'. While not using a physical enrichment column (like TiO2), the assay is specifically targeted at the glycoproteome and deamidated proteome of Trf and Cp.

scope: Plasma serum was isolated and subjected to biochemical and proteomics analysis, and protein turnover measurement.

Serum (20 µl) was diluted with phosphate buffer saline pH 7.4 (1:1 v/v), ApoB-depleted using an Mg2+/dextran sulfate reagent (4 µl) from Stanbio (Boerne, TX), and delipidated with ice-cold acetone (1:10, v/v).
Plasma serum (20 µl) was apolipoprotein-B-depleted and acetone-precipitated.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material is plasma serum. While ApoB-depletion and delipidation were performed to remove interfering particles, this is a cleanup step for a bulk fluid (serum) rather than an affinity-purification of a specific protein complex or a subcellular organelle fraction. Per the mapping rules, bulk cellular/fluid extracts are categorized as whole cell lysate (PPA:0000194).
